title: The Browser's settings move inside Assistant settings

steps.headline: Browser is no longer its own row in Settings.
steps.changed: The "Browser" row between Assistant settings and Appearance is gone. Its settings are now a page inside Assistant settings (next step), as you asked on the last page.
steps.notice: The Assistant settings row still reads "Models, permissions, defaults"; I didn't add "browser" to it, to keep it short.
steps.risk: Anyone who already knew the Browser row has one more click to reach it. The Browser panel in a chat is unchanged.

steps.path: Settings → Assistant settings → Browser (last in the list)
steps.headline: The same Browser settings, now the last page of Assistant settings.
steps.changed: Every group, word and control you approved on the last page is unchanged; it just sits in Assistant settings beside Permissions and Specialists. The one-line explanation that was under the old popup's title now sits behind the (i) next to the page title, like Local models.
steps.notice: The page only appears on the computer itself — not on the phone app or remote access, same as before. The "are you sure" popups for switching browsers and signing out still appear on top.
steps.risk: Before pictures are the popup you approved last round; after pictures are the page. The page is wider, so the longer descriptions wrap less.
